plan: Drive: from Stuie, about 167 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 51.24486, -125.63464, where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: 3.7 km on unnamed roads and trails by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 100 m NW, climb about 0 m.
Hunt: deer, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2007 cutblock (right here) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
